Isolated tumor cells (ITCs) are defined as single tumor cells or small clusters not greater
than 0.2 mm, usually detected by immunohistochemical (IHC) or molecular methods. ITCs do not usually show evidence of malignant activity (e.g., proliferation or stromal reaction).
Lymph nodes with ITCs only are not counted as positive nodes for Summary Stage
